consts.name: ddbPositiveGainDieSides
consts.comment: the Positive Material plane, the Plane of Life: every round an unprotected character gains 2d6 hit points - at greater than twice his original total he EXPLODES; escape first and the extra points fade in 1d20 true turns (damage taken from them first).

consts.name: ddbNegativeDrainDieSides
consts.comment: the Negative Material plane, the Plane of Death: the unprotected traveler loses 2d6 hit points AND one level or hit die per round; at zero hit points or levels he shrivels and dies.

consts.name: ddbEnergyVisionYards
consts.comment: vision and detection are limited to 10 yards - the light of the Positive and the darkness of the Negative are each too intense to see farther.

consts.name: ddbBorderCollapsePct
consts.comment: the Border Ethereal is WEAKENED by the energy planes: each turn spent in it carries a 10% chance the Border pulls back and strands the traveler in the adjoining energy plane.

consts.name: ddbXegGuideRoll
consts.comment: the xeg-ya and xeg-yi, the two known inhabitants: mindless but possibly persuadable as guides, on a roll of 8 or better on 2d6 - and no inducement changes the creature's mind if the roll fails.

bools.name: ddbEnergyHostile
bools.comment: the energy planes are thoroughly hostile to outside life, worse than the four majors put together - no Greater, Lesser or Demi-Powers inhabit them.

bools.name: ddbProtectionParadox
bools.comment: the only protections are negative/positive plane protection - but they CANNOT be cast in the energy planes (they draw on the opposite plane); elemental protections cannot be modified to cover energy effects.

bools.name: ddbNoBreathingEnergy
bools.comment: you cannot breathe energy, nor transform it into a breathable mixture (airy element fails): only breath-negating devices (an ibo stone) or spells permit more than breath-holding time.

bools.name: ddbNoRandomEncounters
bools.comment: there are NO random encounters in the energy planes: the destructive nature of the plane quickly destroys elemental pockets, and the native creature types remain undetermined.

bools.name: ddbMagicMaxMinRule
bools.comment: the magic rule: created matter is destroyed one round after creation (exploding in harmless motes in the Positive, collapsing to dust in the Negative); variable spells deal MAXIMUM damage in the Positive, MINIMUM in the Negative; multi-round damage spells last one round; summoned creatures of average-plus intelligence may simply decline to appear.

bools.name: ddbUndeadNegativeLink
bools.comment: many undead draw their animating force from the Negative Material - the source of their level and ability drains - yet no undead are recorded IN either energy plane, only in the quasi-planes; the trilloch, the energy vulture, thrives in the Negative after its demi-plane was consumed.
